captures.title: Chickpea skillet
captures.text: For two servings, warm one 400 g can of chickpeas with 200 g chopped tomatoes in a pan until hot. Serve with bread.

captures.title: Quick pasta
captures.text: For two servings, cook 200 g dry pasta according to its packet. Warm 250 g tomato sauce, then mix with the cooked pasta.
captures.note: Good for a quick weeknight meal.

goal: Review this agent architecture using the saved technical material.
work: Every agent shares a long-lived credential. Tools accept any request if a credential is present. Revocation has no test.

captures.title: Permission boundaries
captures.text: For each tool call, identify principal, action and resource. Check whether that principal is allowed to perform that action on that resource; a credential's presence alone is not authorization.
captures.note: Important perspective on permission boundaries, but do not treat this as company policy.

captures.title: Revocation exercise
captures.text: Test expiry and revocation independently. For example, revoke a test credential and verify that its next protected operation is denied.
captures.note: Useful exercise for our architecture review.

captures.title: Agent talk
captures.note: Watch before treating the advice as authoritative.

result_sections: The design does not distinguish principal, action and resource. Credential presence alone does not satisfy the supplied method. The sources do not establish company policy.
Define authorization for each principal/action/resource combination. Add separate expiry and revocation tests, including a protected call after test-credential revocation.
limitations: The notes guide a scoped review; this is not a complete security assessment or company policy.
